note.zh-TW: 以百分比變動解讀（T20）；模板以營業毛利近似邊際貢獻（T26）。
note.en: Read as a ratio of percentage changes (T20); the template approximates contribution margin with gross profit (T26).

definition.zh-TW: 營業收入變動一些時，營業利益會放大變動多少倍。固定成本越高，槓桿度越大：景氣好時獲利放大，景氣差時也跌得更兇。
definition.en: How many times more operating profit moves when revenue moves. More fixed costs mean a higher degree: profit rises faster in good times and falls faster in bad ones.

ifrsNote.zh-TW: IFRS 不定義財務比率；這個名稱是國際通用說法，計算口徑以指標登錄檔的版本為準。
ifrsNote.en: IFRS does not define financial ratios. The name follows international usage; the calculation basis is the version in the ratio registry.
